items.title: Bob Hardaway interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 14, 1999
items.q: Les Brown had — the staff rhythm section was former Les Brown people so when he got that show he was comfortable with them

ctx.x: I think the show was on ten years, and I was on there seven. And when the staff orchestra ended then I left because I got a chance to do the Carol Burnett Show, which was a better paying show. And as a matter of fact I had a tenor solo on the theme of the Dean Martin show that was very prominent, and was heard throughout the country. And Les Brown © Fillius Jazz Archive -11-

was the bandleader on the show. And then he’d go on the road and they’d ask the tenor player if he was the one that played on the — and he wasn’t. He wasn’t even on the show, you know, if he played that solo. So it got a lot of exposure.
